about.heading: About
about.description: I craft visual narratives that move people. With 4+ years of hands-on experience across After Effects, Unreal Engine, and beyond, I transform ideas into cinematic motion.
about.descriptionSecondary: From logo animations and brand films to short-form social content and 3D real-time environments, I bring versatility and craft to every project. Every frame is an opportunity to tell a story.

contact.heading: Let's create something extraordinary
contact.description: Have a project in mind? I'd love to hear about it. Drop me a line and let's bring your vision to life.
